responsibility: Builds IRA’s internal allocation IR for a function. This file creates the loop-tree region structure, allocnos, allocno objects, preferences, and copy records; maps pseudos to region-local allocnos; invokes cost computation and live-range creation; forms caps and propagates allocno information across nested regions; and prepares the conflict-id/object tables and summary statistics that later coloring and reload/LRA interaction consume. It is the construction and teardown layer for IRA’s region-based model, not the allocator itself.
